page.overview:
What is Of Wolf and Man?

Of Wolf and Man is the 9th track off of Metallica's eponymous fifth studio album, Metallica (The Black Album). It's written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Kirk Hammett.

Of Wolf and Man explores the perspective of a werewolf; a shapeshifting supernatural beast that takes the form of a wolf that hunts in a malevolent predatory way.

Off through the new day's mist I run Out from the new day's mist I have come

I hunt Therefore I am Harvest the land Taking of the fallen lamb
